DIAGNOSIS READY: Right-sided Kidney Stone (Nephrolithiasis).

Based on your history of right flank pain radiating to the groin, visible hematuria, and the absence of fever or chills, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of a kidney stone causing ureteral obstruction.
